brief.subject: JRC publishes Version 4 of its 2020 Global Forest Cover map
brief.headline: JRC Updates Its 2020 Global Forest Cover Map to Version 4
brief.dek: The EU's Joint Research Centre has published a new version of its 2020 forest map, and heat is adding pressure on cocoa supply.
brief.lede: The EU Joint Research Centre has released Version 4 of its Global Forest Cover map for 2020. Compliance teams should note which version their geolocation checks use.

sections.heading: New 2020 forest map from JRC
bullets: The Joint Research Centre published Version 4 of the Global Forest Cover map, covering the year 2020.
The release came through the European Commission's environment newsroom on 2026-10-19.
Teams screening plot coordinates against 2020 forest status should confirm which map version their checks rely on.
The announcement gives no details on what changed from earlier versions, so review the new layer before relying on it.

sections.heading: Heat adds pressure on cocoa
bullets: Rising temperatures are affecting cocoa supplies, adding a risk to supply beyond price swings.
More frequent heatwaves are also changing chocolate demand, and manufacturers are revising formats and retail strategies.
Cocoa exporters and cooperatives may face buyers shifting product plans as climate pressure grows.

brief.seo_description: EUDR brief: the JRC releases Version 4 of its 2020 Global Forest Cover map, and rising heat puts pressure on cocoa supply and chocolate demand.

items.title: Chocolate has a new problem. And it’s not cocoa prices
items.snippet: Rising temperatures are reshaping the chocolate industry, impacting both cocoa supplies and consumer demand. As heatwaves become more frequent, manufacturers are adapting formats, product strategies and retail approaches to protect sales in a warming world.

items.title: Creamers move beyond coffee with flavors, cold foams and café-inspired experiences
items.snippet: SPINS data shows consumers gravitating toward flavored creamers and cold foams that deliver café-inspired flavors and textures, while dairy-focused brands balance indulgence with simpler ingredient lists.
